title: Beyond Uncertainty Reduction: Calibrated Planning for Interactive Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2608.27847v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Interactive medical diagnosis requires an agent to gather patient evidence through sequential questions before committing to a diagnosis. Large language models (LLMs) now make such consultations feasible, and existing approaches typically select questions by how much they reduce uncertainty among candidate diseases. However, this objective is insensitive to the unequal clinical costs of diagnostic errors and omitted severe alternatives, so minimizing uncertainty need not minimize final diagnostic loss. To bridge this gap, we propose CaRDI (Calibrated Risk for Diagnostic Interaction), a planning framework built around a clinical loss combining primary diagnosis error with severity-weighted differential omission. Diagnostic and safety beliefs estimate the two loss components, while conformal residual calibration corrects for underestimation from partial evidence. The calibrated risk then guides question selection and stopping by balanc

translated_title: 超越不确定性降低：面向交互式诊断的校准规划
translated_abstract: 交互式医疗诊断要求智能体在给出最终诊断之前，通过一系列序贯提问来收集患者证据。大型语言模型（LLM）如今使这类自动化问诊成为可能，而现有方法通常依据候选疾病之间不确定性降低的程度来选择下一个问题。然而，这一目标对不同诊断错误与遗漏严重疾病所造成的临床代价差异并不敏感，因此最小化不确定性并不一定能够最小化最终诊断损失。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了CaRDI（Calibrated Risk for Diagnostic Interaction，面向诊断交互的校准风险），一个围绕临床损失构建的规划框架，该损失将主要诊断错误与按严重程度加权的鉴别诊断遗漏相结合。诊断信念与安全信念分别估计这两个损失组成部分，同时采用保形残差校准来纠正由不完整证据导致的低估。校准后的风险随后通过平衡……（指导问题选择与停止时机）
tldr: 该论文提出CaRDI框架，用经过保形校准的临床风险（结合主诊断错误与严重鉴别诊断遗漏的加权损失）取代传统的不确定性降低目标，以指导基于大语言模型的交互式医疗问诊中的提问选择与停止时机。
en_tdlr: CaRDI replaces uncertainty reduction with conformally calibrated clinical risk—combining primary diagnosis error and severity-weighted omission of severe differentials—to guide question selection and stopping in LLM-based interactive medical diagnosis.
